comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
ten trades can't tell you much yet, and two losers taking back half of eight winners says the stop is doing the damage, not the six checks. I'd replay those checks over two or three years of option chains before changing them, filled at the ask going in and the bid going out. Quantradin, a free tester I built, does that replay on paper. quantradin.com

where does the stop sit, a fixed % of premium?

replies.author: Lost-Sock-3869
replies.body: Yes the stops are doing the damage as it’s not hitting on point. While my TGTs are on point and the limit orders get accepted, but while reversal the stop loss limit orders are lagging heavily. The bot freaks out and tries to close the position multiple times, and ends up closing 20-40% below the stop loss limit order. 2-3 years is a lot, how many no. of trades do you expect in these years? Will backtest help since it’s not proven?

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: that sounds like two problems stacked. a stop-limit on an option can sit unfilled once the bid drops through your limit, and the bot firing new closes on top of a working order makes it worse. one exit order alive at a time, cancel confirmed before the next, and a marketable limit walked down from the bid fixes most of it.
